name: Law Firm
description: Billing and matter defaults for the Law Firm toolkit. The Research Assistant select is omitted because its options come from the assistant store.

settings.label: Default jurisdiction
settings.description: Court jurisdiction used for new matters and filings.

settings.label: Default state
settings.description: Two-letter abbreviation (CA, NY, TX). Values are upper-cased and truncated to two characters.

settings.label: Default billing rate (per hour)
settings.description: Applied to time entries and fee calculations without their own rate.

settings.label: Billing increment
settings.description: Minimum billed slice: 0.1 is the ABA six-minute standard, 0.25 is fifteen minutes.

settings.label: Enable trust accounting
settings.description: Enables IOLTA trust management, reconciliation and retainer balance monitoring.

settings.label: Enable firm dashboard
settings.description: Shows utilisation, revenue forecasts and matter analytics.

settings.label: Enable Research & Add
settings.description: Enables the AI-assisted legal research page.
